messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["very important during pregnancy", "during pregnancy", "controlling diabetes is very important", "higher during pregnancy", "stopping antidepressant during pregnancy", "continuing antidepressant during pregnancy", "gaining the right amount of weight is very important", "follow doctor's instructions during pregnancy", "may cause complications during pregnancy", "pregnancy registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy", "women who use Wegovy during pregnancy", "dose needs may be different during pregnancy", "some conditions require steroid treatment during pregnancy", "risk of depression if discontinued during pregnancy", "depression comes back if discontinued during pregnancy", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of high blood pressure in pregnancy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
